content: {"episode_id":"ep-05103","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93271, cardiac event monitoring, for episode ep-05103. The clinical indication note documents a patient with a history of recurrent palpitations and episodes of syncope (R55), raising concern for underlying arrhythmia, with clinical evaluation suggesting paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1) as potential etiologies for these intermittent symptoms. As stated in the note, a cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management. We request reconsideration of the PR-204 determination and payment of the outstanding balance of 398.38 for this service."}
